description: This file defines classes for implementing the Visitor design pattern to traverse and operate on models from the behave testing framework, specifically model elements like Feature, Rule, ScenarioOutline, Scenario, and Step.

classes.name: IModelVisitor
classes.description: Interface for visiting behave model elements, with methods to handle features, rules, scenario outlines, scenarios, and steps.

classes.name: ModelVisitor
classes.description: Abstract external visitor class implementing traversal logic for behave model elements, supporting delegation and inheritance-based visitation.

methods.name: should_continue_visit
methods.description: Determines whether to continue visiting based on the return value of a visit method.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Allows the visitor to be called as a function, visiting a single item or a list/tuple of items.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Dispatches to specific visit methods based on the type of the model element.

methods.name: visit_many
methods.description: Visits multiple items in an iterable, optionally using a custom visit function.

methods.name: visit_items_of
methods.description: Visits all items contained within a container.

methods.name: visit_feature
methods.description: Visits a Feature element and its contained items.

methods.name: visit_rule
methods.description: Visits a Rule element and its contained items.

methods.name: visit_scenario_outline
methods.description: Visits a ScenarioOutline element and its scenarios.

methods.name: visit_scenario
methods.description: Visits a Scenario element and its steps.
